propositions: add_comment returns raw ACLI batch mutation envelope {"results": [...], "successCount": N} instead of normalized comment resource, violating declared return type and creating shape mismatch with consumers

gap between transport return shape and consumer expectations (reading result["id"] as comment id) enabled bug where Cloud posts received no comment id and silently re-posted until hitting Jira's 5000-comment cap
add_comment is the only --json consumer in acli_cli_ops that skips normalization/verification at transport boundary, unlike sibling operations (get_comments, get_issue, create_issue)

normalizer must distinguish between DC/REST-shaped resource payloads (pass through verbatim), Cloud batch envelopes (normalize to {"id": None, "acli_envelope": <parsed>}), and unrecognized shapes (raise loudly)
